sentences.en: He ought to be punished if he commits a crime.
sentences.zh: 如果他犯罪了，就应该受到惩罚。

sentences.en: The prominent poet attempted to commit suicide in his study.
sentences.zh: 这位著名诗人曾在书房里试图自杀。

sentences.en: The man assured us that she didn't commit the murder.
sentences.zh: 那人向我们保证说她没有犯下谋杀罪。

senses.zh: 犯罪, 做错(坏)事；承诺, 使承担义务, 使作出保证, 使卷入；委托, 把…托付给；调拨 (钱、资源)
